content.short: Turbos is a hyper-efficient CLMM DEX on Sui backed by Mysten Labs, offering optimized concentrated liquidity.
content.description:
Turbos Finance is a leading decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide users with a professional-grade trading experience. Developed in close collaboration with Mysten Labs and backed by Jump Crypto, the platform utilizes a Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker (CLMM) model that allows liquidity providers to allocate their capital within specific price ranges. This approach significantly increases fee capture for providers and reduces slippage for traders compared to traditional AMM structures.

Leveraging Sui's high throughput and sub-second finality, Turbos delivers a seamless and highly responsive venue for asset exchange that prioritizes user sovereignty. The protocol features professional-grade trading tools, including limit orders and automated liquidity management vaults to maximize capital efficiency. As a foundational pillar of the Sui DeFi landscape, Turbos is dedicated to providing the essential infrastructure needed for mass adoption and sophisticated on-chain trading, empowering participants to manage their portfolios with unparalleled precision.
content.meta: Turbos offers professional-grade concentrated liquidity trading and high-speed AMM pools on the Sui blockchain.
